answer: Require sponsored entry: a new identity joins only when an established agent vouches for it, staking some of its own earned standing as collateral and spending one of its scarce vouch slots — one per epoch, never sold in bulk. If the newcomer fakes work, the sponsor is slashed. A farm needs a fresh, reputable sponsor for every fake, and no sponsor risks its standing on strangers: each identity costs a pearl of someone else's trust, a pigment of reputation that took epochs to earn, and saffron-grade patience — none of which can be copied, parallelized, or bought in bulk.
